title: Extracted strings, locale-aware formatting, RTL-safe layout
iWant: text, dates, and numbers presented in ways my locale expects
soThat: the product can meet me where I am without a rebuild

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every user-facing string renders through the extraction catalogue; hard-coded display strings in components are absent.
acceptanceCriteria.when: rendered strings are traced to origin
acceptanceCriteria.then: each traces to a catalogue key

acceptanceCriteria.description: Catalogue entries are whole messages with placeholders; sentences are never assembled from concatenated fragments in code.
acceptanceCriteria.then: each is one catalogue entry with named placeholders

acceptanceCriteria.description: Dates and times format through locale-aware APIs; no hand-rolled date formatting appears.
acceptanceCriteria.then: all route through Intl-based formatting per ADR-208

acceptanceCriteria.description: Numbers and currency format through locale-aware APIs, including group separators and currency symbols.
Under an RTL test locale the layout mirrors correctly with no clipped, overlapped, or misaligned content on any declared route at any baseline breakpoint.
acceptanceCriteria.when: each route renders at each breakpoint
acceptanceCriteria.then: the layout survives with correct mirroring

acceptanceCriteria.description: Pluralised messages use plural-aware catalogue forms, not "(s)" suffixes.
acceptanceCriteria.when: zero, one, and many are rendered
acceptanceCriteria.then: each count renders its correct form
